added.title: Bust a Move
added.info: Unleash your inner dancer and surprise the world with your break-dancing skills. It's a fun and spontaneous way to express yourself and bring joy to others with your moves.

added.title: Split Decision
added.info: Challenge your flexibility and physical capabilities by attempting a split. It's a great way to improve your range of motion while also being a fun and impressive feat.

added.title: Slope of Enlightenment
added.info: Dive into the fascinating world of calculus by learning about differentiation. It's a key concept in higher math that can broaden your intellectual horizons and deepen your understanding of change.

added.title: Airtime
added.info: Experience the joy of weightlessness by jumping on a trampoline. It's a fun and playful way to exercise, boost your mood, and feel like a kid again.

added.title: Amnesty
added.info: Take a step towards personal growth by forgiving someone who has caused you pain. Forgiveness isn't about condoning past actions but about freeing yourself from negative emotions.

added.title: Cushion Theory
added.info: Add a touch of humor to your day by playing a harmless prank. Keep it lighthearted, ensure no one gets hurt, and enjoy the laughter that follows.

added.title: Decimal Shift
added.info: Spread unexpected generosity by leaving an unusually large tip. It's a way to brighten someone's day and make a memorable positive impact.

added.title: Dark Horse
added.instruction: Buy stocks in an obscure company.
added.info: Take a walk on the wild side of investing by buying stock in a lesser-known company. While risky, this move can introduce you to the complexities of the stock market.

added.title: The Third Place
added.info: Enjoy the social atmosphere of a bar and unwind with your friends or make new acquaintances. This allows you to relax, socialize, and enjoy a change of scenery.

added.title: Serendiparty
added.instruction: Find someone whose birthday is today.
added.info: Engage in a fun social experiment by trying to find someone who is celebrating their birthday today. It can lead to new connections and shared joy, fostering a sense of community.

added.title: Retrograde
added.info: Delve into the world of astrology and discover how stars and planets may influence our lives. This ancient system can provide insight into your personality, relationships and future.

added.title: Six Degrees
added.instruction: Connect two concepts with Wikipedia links.
added.info: Test your internet savvy by connecting two seemingly unrelated concepts using only Wikipedia links. This is a fun way to expand your knowledge and discover how everything is interconnected.

added.title: Ghost in the Machine
added.instruction: Install an app you will never use.
added.info: Experience the digital world by downloading a random app that you will most likely never use. It will be a digital artifact, taking up space, a funny reminder of this moment.

added.title: Skin Deep+
added.info: Express your individuality with a tattoo, a permanent form of body art. Choose a design that is meaningful to you and reflects your personality.

added.title: Slick Move
added.info: Enjoy the thrill and fun of ice skating, either alone or with friends. This activity improves your balance and coordination while providing a fun way to stay active.

added.title: Once or Twice Upon
added.instruction: Reread a book you read years ago.
added.info: Relive cherished stories and discover new meanings by rereading a book you enjoyed in the past. It can be like visiting old friends and experiencing the magic anew.

added.title: Babelbite
added.info: Expand your taste experience by trying a packaged snack from another country. It's a fun and easy way to explore different cuisines and flavors.

added.title: Yes, And
added.info: Embrace spontaneity by saying 'yes' to every reasonable request for a whole day. It is a way to embrace new opportunities and let the world surprise you.

added.title: No, Because
added.info: Practice asserting your boundaries by saying 'no' to every request for a day. It's a way to prioritize your own needs and reflect on what you are actually willing to do.

added.title: Alto Ego
added.instruction: Talk in a high pitched voice all day.
added.info: Add a touch of whimsy to your day by speaking in a high-pitched voice. It's a playful way to express yourself and perhaps see how others respond to a new vocal style.

added.title: Recitativo
added.info: Transform your day into a musical by singing everything you say. This can be a fun and expressive challenge that brings creativity and rhythm into your daily life.

added.title: Ctrl Alt Delight
added.info: Show your laptop some love by performing a maintenance checkup. This helps keep your computer in optimal condition, ensuring its smooth and reliable operation.

added.title: Right On
added.info: Expand your vocabulary and knowledge of geometry by learning the definition of "orthogonal". It's a term with important applications in mathematics and various other fields.

added.title: Alkebulan
added.instruction: Learn the names of all African countries.
added.info: Expand your geographic knowledge by learning the names of all African countries. This act increases your global awareness and appreciation of cultural diversity.

added.title: Middlemarch
added.instruction: Read only page 49 of a book.
added.info: Engage in a unique literary experience by reading only page 49 of a book. It is a way to explore the author's writing style and potentially discover a new favorite book from a single page.

added.title: One Wheel Wonder
added.instruction: Watch a video of unicycle riding.
added.info: Explore a unique activity by watching a video of unicycle riding. It is a way to appreciate the skill, balance, and artistry required to master this unusual form of transportation.

added.title: Sole-searching
added.instruction: Take one photo of all your shoes.
added.info: Document your personal style by taking a photo of all your shoes. It is a visual archive of your footwear, allowing you to reflect on your wardrobe and make new outfits.

added.title: Deciduous
added.info: Connect with nature by searching for 5 unique leaves. It's a great way to observe the diversity of plant life around you and appreciate the beauty in natural forms.

added.title: Ephemeral
added.instruction: Write something vague on a sticky note.
added.info: Add a touch of mystery to your day by writing something vague on a sticky note. It's a way to spark curiosity and encourage others to interpret your enigmatic message.

added.title: Door-hinge
added.info: Engage in a playful word challenge by trying to find 10 words that rhyme with "orange". It's a fun exercise for your brain that tests your vocabulary and creativity.
